;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] says three people have been killed and three others injured after a [[funeral]] procession in [[Tartar District]] was shelled by [[Armenia]]n forces, while the Armenian prosecutor-general's office says two soldiers were killed in a [[drone strike]] in [[Vardenis]]; the soldiers were not involved in military action. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20201015-nagorno-karabakh-ceasefire-hopes-sink-as-death-toll-rises/ (Middle East Monitor)]  

;Business and economy
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
**[[Hawaii]] is expected to reopen [[Tourism in Hawaii|tourism]] to the public and lift the statewide mandatory [[quarantine]] for travellers who test negative. However, visitors will be required to wear masks and go through temperature screenings. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/hawaii-reopening-october-15-what-to-expect/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/hawaii-officially-reopen-for-tourism-what-travelers-need-to-know.html (TravelPulse.com)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]], [[First COVID-19 tier regulations in England|COVID-19 tier regulations in England]]
*****[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] announces that [[London]], [[Essex]], [[York]], and other areas will be put under tier 2 restrictions on October 17, which means that different households will be banned from mixing indoors, including inside homes, pubs, and restaurants, and people will also be told to avoid public transport and non-essential travel. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-54551596 (BBC News)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-10-15/london-tier-2-covid-19-lockdown-with-millions-banned-from-mixing/12772826 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports 793 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new record for the second day in a row. [https://www.total-croatia-news.com/news/47403-croatia-s-coronavirus-update-793-new-and-3562-active-cases-10-related-deaths (Total Croatia News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports a record of 104 cases in the past 24 hours, surpassing 100 for the first time since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2020/10/15/coronavirus-anastasiades-appeals-to-public-after-whopping-104-new-cases-update-3/ (''Cyprus-Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record 9,544 new cases in the last 24 hours, its highest single day tally since the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] began, according to data from the [[Ministry of Health (Czech Republic)|Health Ministry]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1749186/world (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record 30,621 new infections in a single day as the cumulative number of cases surpasses 800,000. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/521302-france-sets-another-one-day-record-with-more-than-30000-new-covid-19 (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The number of new cases in [[Germany]] surges by 6,638 in the last 24 hours, according to official data from the [[Robert Koch Institute]], a new record not seen since the pandemic began, which previously reported 6,294 cases on March 28. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/wires/20201015-germany-sees-6638-daily-virus-cases-highest-start-pandemic (RFI)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The [[Government of Greece|Greek government]] places the northern regional unit of [[Kozani (regional unit)|Kozani]] on lockdown, as the region is declared an "increased threat." The measure, applicable until October 29, implies the use of masks at all sites; the prohibition of meetings in public and private spaces; the ban to travel outside the region; and the closure of restaurants, gyms, museums, courts, and shops, and the suspension of festivals. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/258125/article/ekathimerini/news/kozani-in-lockdown-due-to-high-virus-load (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] registers 8,804 new infections in the past 24 hours, according to the [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|health ministry]], a new record for the second consecutive day since the start of the outbreak in the country. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/italys-covid-19-cases-surge-to-new-daily-record-of-nearly-9000 (''Daily Sabah'')]
****[[Campania]] announces that it will shut down schools until the end of this month, in an effort to curb an increase of COVID-19 cases in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-italy-campania/italys-campania-region-to-shut-down-schools-to-curb-surge-in-covid-19-infections-statement-idUSKBN2702MG (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****After new cases reaches a record 8,099 cases in a single day, [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] announces new restrictions in [[Warsaw]] and other major cities that considered a "red" zone from October 17. All secondary schools in those areas will be closed, restaurants will close at 9 p.m. local time, weddings will be banned and there will be stricter limits on the numbers of people allowed in shops and on public transport and at religious services. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/poland-announces-partial-lockdown-amid-record-covid-19-cases (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports 2,101 new daily cases, its highest daily increase yet, bringing the cumulative count to 93,294 confirmed cases. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/227_DGS_boletim_20201015.pdf (DGS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports an all-time high of 745 cases in the past day. Cumulative numbers pass 10,000 cases. [https://www.rtvslo.si/zdravje/novi-koronavirus/v-sredo-rekordnih-745-pozitivnih-primerov-ena-smrtna-zrtev/539177 (RTVSLO)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****Cinema halls, theatres and multiplexes, entertainment parks, educational institution and swimming pools outside containment zones reopened in several states across [[India]] as part of measures allowing more activities in the country. [https://www.firstpost.com/india/unlock-5-cinema-halls-entertainment-parks-swimming-pools-and-schools-to-reopen-today-8914341.html (Firstpost)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a single day record of 5,810 new recoveries in the past 24 hours, taking the nationwide total of recoveries to 273,661. From that number, 2,223 new recoveries came from [[Central Java]]. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5214861/sebaran-rekor-5810-kasus-sembuh-corona-15-oktober-terbanyak-dari-jateng?tag_from=wpm_nhl_17 (''detikNews'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports 409 new recoveries in the last 24 hours. This is the highest number in a single day since the outbreak began, bringing the total number of recoveries to 12,014. according to [[Ministry of Health (Malaysia)|Director-General of Health]] [[Noor Hisham Abdullah]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2020/10/632602/covid-19-589-new-cases (''New Straits Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Netherlands–Russia relations]]
**The [[Politics of the Netherlands|Dutch government]] urges [[Russia]] to return to negotiation tables after the country withdrew from talks on liability for the downing of [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 17]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-mh17-russia-int/russia-withdraws-from-mh17-talks-with-netherlands-and-australia-idUSKBN27016T (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
**The [[National Police (France)|French police]] have raided the homes of senior government and health officials such as [[Minister of Health (France)|Health Minister]] [[Olivier Véran]] and the director of the national health agency, [[Jérôme Salomon]], as part of an investigation into their handling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in France|pandemic in the country]]. It comes after [[Cour de Justice de la République|a court]] launched an inquiry earlier this year. [[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] is also under investigation, according to French media. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54535358 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**Police raid the offices of prominent [[pro-democracy]] activist [[Jimmy Lai]] ahead of his scheduled appearance in court where he has been charged with 'unlawful assembly'. Lai is the owner of the publishing company [[Next Digital]] and newspaper ''[[Apple Daily]]''. [https://www.dw.com/en/hong-kong-activist-jimmy-lais-office-raided-by-police-ahead-of-hearing/a-55282757 (DW)]
*[[Capital punishment in Bangladesh]]
**A court in [[Bangladesh]] sentences five men [[capital punishment|to death]] for the [[gang rape]] of a girl in 2012. The verdict comes amidst public outcry regarding growing [[sexual violence]]. It was the first conviction since the [[government of Bangladesh|government]] this week introduced the death penalty for rape. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/15/bangladesh-sentences-five-men-to-death-for-2012-gang-rape-of-teen (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot]]
**Police announce the arrest of a fourteenth suspect in relation to a foiled kidnapping plot targeting [[Governor of Michigan|Michigan Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]]. He has been charged at the state level with material support of an act of terrorism. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2020/10/15/whitmer-plot-charges-nessel/3661482001/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]
*[[End SARS]]
**Over ten people are killed during a demonstration against the [[Nigeria Police Force|police force]] of [[Nigeria]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/protests-nigerias-police-kill-10-charges-amnesty-73626736 (ABC News)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**Gen. [[Salvador Cienfuegos]], Mexico's [[Secretariat of National Defense (Mexico)|minister of defence]] during the [[Enrique Peña Nieto|Peña Nieto]] administration, is arrested in the United States on drugs charges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54552057 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Biden–Ukraine conspiracy theory]], [[Conspiracy theories related to the Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**[[Twitter]] locks [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] Twitter account for sharing private information without that person's permission, relating to a controversial [[Hunter Biden]] video. His account has since been unlocked. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/twitter-trump-campaign-account-video-hunter-biden (Fox News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[C-SPAN]] indefinitely suspends its political editor [[Steve Scully]] after admitting he lied about his [[Twitter]] account being hacked earlier this month. Scully had been selected by the [[Commission on Presidential Debates]] to moderate the now cancelled second presidential debate of the election. On October 8, Scully tweeted "@[[Anthony Scaramucci|Scaramucci]] should I respond to trump" after being publicly criticized by President Trump. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/15/media/steve-scully-cspan-suspended/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Kyrgyzstan protests]]
**[[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] [[Sooronbay Jeenbekov]] resigns following ten days of unrest and protests in response to the [[October 2020 Kyrgyz parliamentary election|parliamentary election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/kyrgyzstan-protests-int/kyrgyzstan-president-jeenbekov-resigns-after-unrest-idUSKBN2700YS (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Thai protests]]
**The [[government of Thailand|government]] issues an [[Law of Thailand|emergency decree]] following yesterday's generally peaceful protests and counter-protests, effective Thursday at 4:00 a.m. [[UTC+07:00|local time]] (Wednesday 21:00 UTC) that bans gatherings of five or more people and forbids the publication of news or online messages that "could harm national security." Two leaders of the anti-government protests, Anon Nampa and [[Panupong Jadnok]], are arrested after the emergency decree became effective. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54548988 (BBC News)]
*[[Immigrant investor programs]]
**President of the [[House of Representatives (Cyprus)|Parliament of Cyprus]]&nbsp;[[Demetris Syllouris]] resigns after being allegedly implicated in a case of sale of passports to investors with criminal records, who do not meet the necessary criteria to be able to move freely within the [[European Union]]. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2020/10/15/under-pressure-syllouris-resigns/ (''Cyprus-Mail'')]

;Science and technology
*[[2020 in paleontology]]
**Researchers announce the fossil discoveries of [[Triassic]] [[drepanosaur]] [[Skybalonyx|Skybalonyx skapter]] at the [[Petrified Forest National Park]] in [[Arizona]]. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2020-10-15/researchers-discover-fossils-of-new-species-in-arizona (''Los Angeles Times'')]
**A boy discovers a fossilized [[hadrosaur]] skeleton at the [[Horseshoe Canyon (Alberta)|Horseshoe Canyon]] in [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], dating back 69 million years.
